## Undergraduate mathematics

**Academic tutor · Sapienza University of Rome · 2024/25–2025/26**

I led lectures and problem-solving sessions for students in the Bachelor’s Degree in Economics and Business. I prepared worked examples, guided students through exercises and helped them get ready for exams.

## Bayesian inference with Cobaya

**Lecturer · Sapienza University of Rome · July 2025**

I designed and delivered six hours of lectures and hands-on sessions for Master’s and PhD students. Students worked through how to set up a cosmological model, estimate its parameters with Cobaya and interpret the resulting constraints.

## Research mentoring

I supported two Master’s students in their thesis research. Both projects led to co-authored journal articles on [viscous dark energy](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jheap.2026.100732) and [metric modified gravity](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jheap.2026.100612). I also supervised an undergraduate research project exploring quintessence models in the context of the Hubble tension.

## Teaching interests

Introductory physics and undergraduate mathematics, general relativity, cosmology and astrophysics, scientific programming, and Bayesian inference.
